name: tutorbench_haiku_v1
status: FINALIZED tutorbench judge config (value pick: ~94% of sonnet MCC, lowest false-pass, ~1/3 cost)
adapter_note: v1 = evidence-first (JSON order: evidence, rationale, verdict).
max_tokens_note: tutorbench responses are long; 4096 gives 0 unscorable for haiku.
parser: regex verdict extraction ("verdict":"pass|fail") with json.loads fallback; fail-closed
auto_fail_policy: generation error / empty / missing -> fail WITHOUT a judge call; length-truncated -> graded
selection_rationale: Cost-conscious pick on the 261-cell tutorbench human set: MCC 0.497 (~94% of sonnet's 0.529), lowest false-pass (22.4%), 0 unscorable, stable, ~1/3 sonnet cost. Cheap GPT tiers (nano/mini) failed as judges. Quality alternative: sonnet-4-6 + v1 (MCC 0.529).
